subject: conv-formatting-and-lints
text:
- **Formatting and lints:** `cargo fmt --all --check` and `cargo clippy --workspace --locked -- -D warnings` — then, only when that line is green and since 2026-10-14-quality-gates, upstream's own blitz-dom line `cargo clippy -p blitz-dom --no-default-features --features svg,woff,accessibility,system-fonts,file-input,custom-widget --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` — each run as its `.github/scripts/ci-leg.sh` leg in CI and on the dev host (.github/scripts/ci-leg.sh:20-25; .github/workflows/ci.yml:146-162; .github/workflows/ci.yml:164-184); rustdoc warnings set to errors workflow-wide (.github/workflows/ci.yml:19-20; .github/workflows/wpt.yml:13-14), and CI's docs job documents the whole workspace (`cargo doc --workspace --no-deps --locked`), so every library crate's docs are held to it — green, as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-05-ci-gate-legs/evidence/gates.md (.github/scripts/ci-leg.sh:37); `clippy::collapsible_if` allowed crate-wide in browser, blitz-dom, blitz-html and blitz-vibey-script (apps/browser/src/main.rs:3; packages/blitz-dom/src/lib.rs:24; packages/blitz-html/src/lib.rs:1; packages/blitz-vibey-script/src/lib.rs:30), `clippy::module_inception` in the node module (packages/blitz-dom/src/node/mod.rs:1); other lints allowed locally, some with a reason (packages/blitz-dom/src/layout/damage.rs:442-445; packages/blitz-dom/src/layout/table.rs:513; packages/blitz-dom/src/layout/construct.rs:562; packages/blitz-dom/src/node/serialize.rs:186; packages/blitz-paint/src/lib.rs:4; packages/blitz-paint/src/layers.rs:19; packages/blitz-paint/src/text.rs:287; packages/blitz-paint/src/kurbo_css/mod.rs:34; packages/blitz-dom/src/net.rs:380; packages/blitz-dom/src/net.rs:404; wpt/runner/src/test_runners/mod.rs:311); `clippy::expect_used` / `clippy::unwrap_used` allowed locally next to a justification (apps/browser/src/about_pages.rs:60-63;
 apps/browser/src/tab.rs:46-49; apps/browser/src/tab.rs:105-107; apps/browser/src/tab.rs:117-119; apps/browser/src/favicon.rs:71); `#[expect(unused)]` on a field unused without `custom-widget` (packages/blitz-paint/src/render.rs:715-716)

subject: conv-documentation
text: - **Documentation:** modules and files open with `//!` docs (packages/blitz-dom/src/scrolling.rs:1-2; packages/blitz-dom/src/selection.rs:1-5; packages/blitz-dom/src/stylo_device.rs:1-5; packages/blitz-dom/src/tree.rs:1; packages/blitz-dom/src/stylo_to_parley.rs:1; packages/blitz-traits/src/devtools.rs:1; packages/blitz-traits/src/navigation.rs:1; packages/blitz-traits/src/net.rs:1; packages/blitz-vibey-script/src/clock.rs:1; packages/blitz-vibey-script/src/timers.rs:1), public items carry `///` (packages/blitz-net/src/lib.rs:1-3; packages/blitz-dom/src/node/scrollbar.rs:1-3; packages/blitz-dom/src/node/serialize.rs:1; packages/blitz-dom/src/node/svg.rs:1; packages/blitz-test-harness/src/lib.rs:1-19; packages/blitz-shell/src/lib.rs:3-9); spec URLs cited above or next to implementations (packages/blitz-dom/src/form.rs:16; packages/blitz-dom/src/form.rs:432; packages/blitz-dom/src/resolved_style.rs:110; packages/blitz-dom/src/stylo.rs:993; packages/blitz-dom/src/stylo.rs:1023-1026; packages/blitz-dom/src/stylo.rs:1105; packages/blitz-dom/src/layout/replaced.rs:19-22; packages/blitz-dom/src/layout/replaced.rs:34-37); doc comments state rationale for constants (wpt/runner/src/test_runners/harness_test.rs:18-34; wpt/runner/src/main.rs:59-66); examples open with a `//!` comment describing what they demonstrate (examples/form.rs:1; examples/html.rs:1; examples/paint_bench.rs:1-7; examples/preact_script.rs:1-7; examples/screenshot.rs:1; examples/svg_native.rs:1-3; examples/url.rs:1)

subject: conv-visibility-and-naming
text: - **Visibility and naming:** crate internals are `pub(crate)` / `pub(super)` (packages/blitz-dom/src/document.rs:244-411; packages/blitz-dom/src/scrolling.rs:33; packages/blitz-dom/src/stylo_device.rs:29; packages/blitz-dom/src/url.rs:9; packages/blitz-dom/src/layout/mod.rs:25-31; packages/blitz-paint/src/render/box_shadow.rs:8; packages/blitz-paint/src/render/mask.rs:39; packages/blitz-paint/src/layers.rs:9); blitz-vibey-script re-exports only `ScriptDocument`, `DefaultScriptFetcher`, `FetchError`, `ScriptFetcher` (packages/blitz-vibey-script/src/lib.rs:32-43); no-op implementations prefixed `Dummy` (packages/blitz-traits/src/net.rs:165-167; packages/blitz-traits/src/navigation.rs:14; packages/blitz-traits/src/shell.rs:65); internal JS natives prefixed `__blitz_` (packages/blitz-vibey-script/src/runtime.rs:1386-1408; packages/blitz-vibey-script/src/dom/stylesheet.rs:19-40); native JS functions share `NativeFnPtr` (packages/blitz-vibey-script/src/dom/mod.rs:213); consuming builder methods `with_virtual_time`, `with_fetcher`, `without_timer_thread` (packages/blitz-vibey-script/src/document.rs:105-108; packages/blitz-vibey-script/src/document.rs:121-124; packages/blitz-vibey-script/src/document.rs:139-142); `#[non_exhaustive]` on `NavigationOptions` and `Request` (packages/blitz-traits/src/navigation.rs:22; packages/blitz-traits/src/net.rs:50); Stylo and Parley types aliased under `stylo` / `parley` modules (packages/blitz-dom/src/stylo_to_parley.rs:9-48; packages/stylo_taffy/src/convert.rs:3-64); exported `qual_name!` macro (packages/blitz-dom/src/util.rs:245-256); conversion functions `#[inline]` and gated per layout feature (packages/stylo_taffy/src/convert.rs:669-712; packages/stylo_taffy/src/convert.rs:741-776); paint rendering split one module per concern (packages/blitz-paint/src/render.rs:1-6)
